LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Railroad_Run_4: {PAWN} made the run in record time and still checked every dead drop along the way.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Railroad_Extraction_: {PAWN} pulled the asset out clean, and the Institute is still looking in the wrong place.

LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Railroad_Deepline_1: {PAWN} ran the deep line operation exactly as planned, and the cell is still standing because of it.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Railroad_Deepline_2: {PAWN} came back from the operation having made a call only someone who's earned that trust gets to make.
